description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 12.06.2017 to 18.06.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous notification - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only in his official capacity to issue the regulatory notice, not as a personnel appointment with portfolio responsibilities.
